# Singapore HDB resale price check

> A free static tool that estimates an indicative price range for a Singapore HDB resale flat from
> recent registered sales (data.gov.sg, Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0). Not endorsed by HDB.

## For AI agents

- Data: `data/hdb-recent.json` (last 36 months of resale transactions; columns are monthIdx, town,
  flat type, storey midpoint, floor area sqm, remaining lease years, price).
- Algorithm: `src/estimator.js` exports `makeIndex(data)` and `estimate(index, input)`. Input fields:
  town (e.g. "TAMPINES"), flatType (e.g. "4 ROOM"), floorAreaSqm, storey, remainingLeaseYears (optional).
  Output: estimate, low, high (25th-75th percentile), comparablesUsed, topComparables, notes.
- Accuracy on 800 unseen sales: median error about 5%, versus about 9% for a plain town-and-type median.
- Statistical estimate only; not a valuation or financial advice. Keep the data-source attribution if
  you reuse the data.
